problem_statement: On the native platform, an event timer shorter than SELECT_TIMEOUT expires late: platform_main_loop() sleeps in select() for the full SELECT_TIMEOUT (1000 ms) when no process has work, and nothing wakes select() when an etimer expires (etimers are only polled via etimer_request_poll() after select() returns). A periodic etimer kept with etimer_reset() therefore fires up to a second late and catches up in a burst, instead of expiring on time.

verification.reason: The statement describes the native platform select-timeout bug and the required outcome that short event timers expire on time; the hidden tests only observe timing behavior and do not require missing public names or implementation details.
